This is a senior-level software engineering role on Cloudflare's Zero Trust team, with a focus on Windows development. The work centers on the Zero Trust desktop client, which routes traffic from corporate devices to Cloudflare's network so web filtering and Zero Trust policies can be applied. The core stack is Rust alongside platform-native languages and APIs — C, C++, Swift, C#, and Python — for high-performance multithreaded networking code, drawing on Windows internals and kernel-mode/driver development plus networking protocols like TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, QUIC, and HTTP/3.
